name: eudkit-vscode
description: Canonical unit completion for eudplib Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript Frontend files from eudkit-lsp.

eudkit.lsp.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `eudkit-lsp` executable. May be absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. When empty, `EUDKIT_LSP_PATH`, `PATH`, and `bin/<platform>-<arch>/eudkit-lsp` are tried in that order.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:types
scripts.test:unit: esbuild test/serverPath.test.ts test/release.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outdir=dist-test && node --test dist-test/serverPath.test.js dist-test/release.test.js
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build -- --production && node scripts/package-vsix.mjs
